contractRule.statement: Only inclusions written on the official package page and/or the Official E-Voucher / Invoice are legally binding package components.

baselineInclusions: private air-conditioned land transport for confirmed itinerary sectors
fuel, tolls, and standard parking fees as per itinerary
hotel or homestay accommodation for listed overnight stays
licensed/vetted crew adjusted by group size and route
listed entrance tickets and environmental/park permits
professional gas mask for Ijen-relevant packages
Ijen medical check and clearance workflow when Ijen is included
daily bottled mineral water in the vehicle
hotel breakfasts for included overnight stays
Java-Bali ferry tickets when listed and specified as included
clear pickup instructions and emergency contacts on voucher
conditionalInclusions: Bali hotel or airport transfers beyond standard ferry crossing
police escort or special convoy arrangements
